lines.en: Gina, I’m late. If I took the bike, I’d be there sooner.
lines.pt: Gina, estou atrasada. Se eu fosse de bicicleta, chegaria mais cedo.

lines.en: If I were you, I’d rent one here. The rental is cheap.
lines.pt: Se eu fosse você, alugaria uma aqui. O aluguel é barato.

lines.en: If I rented a bike, I would need a helmet. Do you sell them?
lines.pt: Se eu alugasse uma bicicleta, precisaria de um capacete. Vocês vendem?

lines.en: Yes. If you bought a helmet today, you would get a free lock.
lines.pt: Sim. Se você comprasse um capacete hoje, ganharia um cadeado grátis.

lines.en: A lock is good. If I left the bike outside, someone might take it.
lines.pt: Um cadeado é bom. Se eu deixasse a bicicleta lá fora, alguém poderia levá-la.

lines.en: That’s right. If I lived near here, I would choose the lane near the river.
lines.pt: Isso mesmo. Se eu morasse perto daqui, escolheria a ciclovia perto do rio.

lines.en: I would feel safer there. If the road were flat, I would ride faster.
lines.pt: Eu me sentiria mais segura lá. Se a rua fosse plana, eu andaria mais rápido.

lines.en: It is mostly flat. You would only need to pedal hard on the bridge.
lines.pt: É quase toda plana. Você só precisaria pedalar forte na ponte.

lines.en: If the tire went flat, would you fix it for me?
lines.pt: Se o pneu furasse, você o consertaria para mim?

lines.en: If you came back here, I would check the tire for free.
lines.pt: Se você voltasse aqui, eu olharia o pneu de graça.

lines.en: Great! If I had more time, I would stay and talk, but I have to go.
lines.pt: Ótimo! Se eu tivesse mais tempo, ficaria para conversar, mas preciso ir.

items.wrong: If I would take the bike, I’d be there.
items.fix: If I took the bike, I’d be there.
items.why: Depois de if use o passado: took, não would take.

items.wrong: If I was you, I rent one.
items.fix: If I were you, I’d rent one.
items.why: Para conselho use If I were you + would.

items.wrong: If I had money, I will buy a bike.
items.fix: If I had money, I would buy a bike.
items.why: O resultado usa would + verbo base.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: If I would take the bike, I’d be there. → If I took the bike, I’d be there. | If I was you, I rent one. → If I were you, I’d rent one. | If I had money, I will buy a bike. → If I had money, I would buy a bike..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

facts.big: If I took the bike, I’d be there sooner
facts.label: Segundo condicional
facts.sub: Use if + passado simples, would + verbo base para situações imaginadas: If I had time, I would stay.

facts.label: Se + passado, + condicional
facts.sub: Use if + passado simples e would + verbo base para uma situação imaginada: If I took the bike, I’d be there sooner. O passado depois de if não fala do passado, mas do que é pouco provável.

facts.label: Se eu fosse você…
facts.sub: Para aconselhar, use If I were you, I would… Mesmo com I, use were nesse caso: If I were you, I’d rent one here. É um conselho educado.

items.s: If I took the bike means I am not taking it now.
items.why: Yes.

items.why: After if we use the past: If I took.

items.why: Yes.

pages.title: A bike shop in Dallas · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot morning in Dallas. Sara is late for a meeting. There is a bike shop on the corner. Gina is fixing a wheel outside. Sara stops and looks at the bikes. She wonders if a bike is faster than a bus.

“Gina, I’m late. If I took the bike, I’d be there sooner.” says Sara. “If I were you, I’d rent one here. The rental is cheap.” says Gina. “If I rented a bike, I would need a helmet. Do you sell them?” says Sara.
